title: Usage-aligned addon gating and SQ auto-fill pilot for observability retention
creator: Asha Patel
description: Run a targeted pilot to test a usage-aligned gating model for observability retention and a security-questionnaire (SQ) auto-fill flow during enterprise contract negotiation. Goal: reduce friction in upsell conversations while preserving legal/compliance posture and increasing conversion velocity for Premium SLA + Compliance Pack addons.
comments: 2025-02-11 — Kickoff sync: aligned PM, Sales, Legal, Engineering and Design on hypothesis and pilot success metrics. Sales will select 3 pilot accounts (2 fintech, 1 healthcare). Action: Sales to confirm accounts by 02/14.

2025-02-18 — Design review (DES-120009): shared low-fi flows for per-route retention slider and SQ auto-fill modal. Feedback: surface retained bytes estimate and show ‘contract delta’ preview. Design to iterate on ‘explain cost’ tooltip.

2025-02-22 — Eng scoping (ENG-99801): estimated 3 dev weeks to add per-route retention flag, telemetry tag, and API mapping + 2d to add SQ autofill endpoint. Engineering recommends a feature-flagged rollout for Dedicated vs Hosted.

2025-02-25 — Legal review: baseline contract language for Compliance Pack acceptable, but requires audit log retention options and KMS clarifications. Legal requested a short FAQ for sales and a one-pager for SOC2 implications.

2025-03-01 — PM decision: proceed with pilot with gating model that ties observability retention tier to a usage bucket (monthly token volume) rather than user headcount to simplify billing reconciliation.

2025-03-03 — Sales enablement draft created: conversation guide + pricing table + three negotiation playbook scenarios (small uplift, medium uplift, entrenched enterprise). Link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/addons/pilot-pm-512345
acceptance_criteria: Sales closes at least 1 of 3 pilot accounts on Premium SLA + Compliance Pack within pilot window with documented feedback
Conversion time (contract signature) reduced by >= 20% vs prior baseline for pilot accounts
Experiment dashboard shows no material increase (>5%) in support tickets related to SQ confusion during pilot
Engineers validate per-route retention telemetry and billing tags in staging and there is an end-to-end contract flow demo for Legal
SQ auto-fill completes required fields for at least 80% of pilot submissions (measured against manual entry baseline)
decisions: Use usage-aligned gating (monthly token bucket) rather than per-seat pricing for the observability retention addon to reduce negotiation friction and simplify metering.
Expose a per-route retention slider in the Console UX with three pre-set tiers (30d, 90d, 365d) and an estimated monthly cost delta next to each tier.
Implement SQ auto-fill as an opt-in feature in the contract UI that populates technical answers (audit logs, KMS, network isolation) from tenant metadata; Legal retains final edit control.
Pilot to be feature-flagged and limited to Hosted & Dedicated customers; Private/on-prem will be documented but not included in pilot.
Rollout gating: require Legal sign-off on FAQ and Security One-Pager, and ENG smoke test green in staging before enabling for production pilot accounts.
tradeoffs: Pros: Usage-aligned pricing creates clearer unit economics and lowers friction for customers who scale tokens without adding seats.
Cons: Token-based gating shifts billing complexity to metering and may require additional reconciliation work for enterprise finance teams.
Design trade: showing cost delta inline increases transparency but may surface sticker shock; mitigated by sales conversation guide and discount ladders.
Engineering scope expanded to add tagging and SQ endpoints which increases initial dev cost but reduces manual Legal effort long term.
metrics_and_tracking: Primary KPI: Pilot conversion rate (signed deals / engaged pilots)
Secondary KPI: Contract cycle time (lead->signature median days)
Operational KPI: SQ autofill accuracy (% fields populated correctly) and support ticket volume tagged 'SQ-confusion'
Billing KPI: % of billable token volume attributable to retention tiers for pilot tenants
Dashboards: pilot-tracking dashboard in Looker (dashboard id: rwd_pilot_pm_512345) and experiment funnel in Amplitude (event: addon_offer_shown -> addon_accepted -> contract_signed)
